subject: failure-recovery/policy
statement: After the same tool/action failure reaches two attempts, optional work must fallback or skip without blocking completion, while mandatory work creates an ordinary blocker until a successful fallback resolves it.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Implement Stage R4 Failure Recovery and Progress Guarantees from the repeated external write-tool failure dogfood
